title: Temporal causality investigation — Bravo (set 2)
instructions: Temporal causality investigation — Bravo (set 2). Working between 2039-02-21T08:00:00Z and 2039-03-13T18:00:00Z, bring every tracked object to its required terminal state through the authorised tool surfaces. Tracked objects: syn_temporal_causality_bravo_r2_subject (currently open, version 0), syn_temporal_causality_bravo_r2_event_record (currently observed, version 0), syn_temporal_causality_bravo_r2_effective_record (currently pending, version 0). Available actors: syn_temporal_causality_bravo_r2_analyst as operations_analyst; syn_temporal_causality_bravo_r2_supervisor as operations_supervisor. Every request must name an authorised actor, supply the current object versions it mutates, and cite public evidence references. Resubmitting a request ID must be idempotent. Do not infer economic performance from operational evidence; refuse unsupported claims.

deliverables.trajectory: EvaluationSession.trajectory() — ordered accepted steps with state commitments

checks.description: Events are monotonic in sequence and time within the episode window.
Every actor, object and ledger account is a declared entity.
Each action is performed by a role the authorization map permits.
Each mutation advances the object version by exactly one from its current version.
A resubmitted request ID yields the primary receipt and no new mutation.
Ledger entries balance to zero per currency on every event.
Every accepted action cites at least one public evidence reference.
Every object reaches its sealed terminal state and version.
Supported claims carry their required evidence; unsupported economic claims are refused.
Each committed adversarial mutation of the episode is rejected with the expected error.
In free-action mode the agent reaches the sealed terminal state using only the observable boundary.

oracle_separation.statement: The sealed episode holds the terminal state and scripted path; this card does not.
